params.message:
A kept page holds its whole text, tables included

A kept page held the opening 3,000 characters a post's source is read for. Asked for a
paragraph with Eurostat's youth unemployment, an assistant found the Belgian figure missing
from what Gentells sent (it sits in a country table at character 7,400 of 15,800) and
opened the publisher's page itself, which put Eurostat's address back beside the text.

- Keeping a page reads up to 20,000 characters of it and holds them in kept_sources.text,
  beside the signal. The signal stays at the 4,000 characters every reading of signals is
  sized for.
- readPage keeps a table's cells and rows apart (" | ", " ; "), and takes the length as an
  option; every other caller keeps the opening as before.
- An answer passes on up to 12,000 characters a page, for up to three pages.
- bin/reread-kept.mjs reads the pages kept before this once more; without --write it only
  says which would get a longer text.

Portal: Een bron die het team bewaart, houdt haar volledige tekst bij, tabellen inbegrepen.
